items.q: Match the following Mogensen stage to its GFR change — 1) I — hyperfiltration  2) II — silent/microalbuminuria  3) III — macroalbuminuria  4) IV — renal impairment … A) ↓  B) =/↓  C) ↑  D) ↓/↑
items.exp: Mogensen table: stage I GFR ↑; II ↓/↑; III =/↓; IV ↓. (Book p816)

items.q: Stage II of Mogensen comprises which pair?
All but one are stage II BP findings on 24-hr ambulatory monitoring. Which is the odd one out?
items.exp: Stage II BP: ↑ on 24-hr ambulatory monitoring; absence of nocturnal dipping; wide pulse pressure. (Book p816)

items.q: The BP progression across Mogensen stages I → IV is:
items.exp: BP: I =/↑; II ↑; III ↑↑; IV ↑↑↑. (Book p816)
